name: Kathy
source:
Kathy is Emily's friend and a fellow lesbian. She is also friends with Alyson. 

She and Emily had a brief fling before it stopped after Kathy introduced Emily to Trisha.

Kathy was friends with Trisha but she has broken off her friendship with Trisha in favour of Emily. This is due to Trisha "bitchy behaviour" towards everyone around her.

Kathy is still attracted to Emily and Kathy is the party animal in Emily's group of friends.

She has had many sexual relationships with other lesbians over the years.
